title: PowerPoint on Mac: Copilot Agent Mode creates executive summary slides
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly presents licence assignment as the only documented governance control tied to Copilot in PowerPoint. Microsoft also documents controls for Copilot experiences and connected-experience privacy settings that affect Copilot in PowerPoint on Mac. The roadmap facts and licence-assignment path and command are supported.

claims.claim: Licence assignment is the one control the Copilot overview ties to Copilot in PowerPoint.
claims.quote: In the admin center, use the Copilot controls to manage Copilot Chat experiences, including Copilot Chat (Basic), Microsoft 365 Copilot (Basic), and Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium).
claims.fix: Remove 'Licence assignment is the one control the Copilot overview ties to Copilot in PowerPoint.' The overview also documents controls for the Basic and Premium experiences; https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/plan/microsoft-365-copilot-privacy additionally states that turning off connected experiences that analyze content makes Copilot unavailable in PowerPoint on current Mac clients. Keep the existing licence-assignment row as a licence control, not an exhaustive governance claim.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Licences can be assigned at Microsoft 365 admin center > Users > Active users > user > Licenses and Apps > Licenses.
claims.quote: In the admin center, go to the Users > Active users page. Select the row of the user that you want to assign a license to. In the right pane, select Licenses and Apps. Expand the Licenses section, select the boxes for the licenses that you want to assign, then select Save changes.

claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense with UserId, AddLicenses containing SkuId, and empty RemoveLicenses assigns a licence to a user.
claims.quote: To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell. Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.claim: Assigning licences requires at least a License or User Administrator role.
claims.quote: You must be at least a License or User Administrator to assign licenses.

claims.claim: Licence assignment is not a separate executive-summary feature switch, and Learn documents no such separate setting.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint executive summary slides Agent Mode admin disable default settings Microsoft Graph PowerShell; "PowerPoint" "Agent Mode" admin settings. Read licence assignment, Copilot overview, requirements and privacy pages; found general controls, not a separate summary-slide switch.
